newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN FIRM BEGINS BUILDING JAKARTA TOWER.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN FIRM BEGINS BUILDING JAKARTA TOWER.

text.p: Indonesian company PT Menara Jakarta, partly owned by PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Telkom) and PT Indonesia Satellite Corp (Indosat), on Tuesday began contruction of a 558-metre high telecommunications tower in Jakarta.
The tower, costing some $560 million, is expected to be completed in 2001.
Telkom and Indosat each own a 20-percent stake in Menara Jakarta. The rest is held by PT Indocitra Grahabawana and a foundation linked to state broadcasting corporation TVRI.
The tower would be used to provide entertainment services such as cable television and interactive games and will also house shopping and banking facilities.
